findings.issue: Still open: featureGrid-1 is laid out as a check list beside its heading, directly under iconList-1, which has the same shape, so two lists of short items stand one under the other; m9 (a two-column check list beside its heading) followed by m10 (an iconList) repeats this further down.
findings.reference: The competitor never stacks two sections laid out the same way, and the site rule has the template set out only one of two same-shape neighbours as a list beside its heading.
findings.fix: In the template's same-shape check, count an iconList as already being a list beside its heading, so a featureGrid next to one keeps its card grid (featureGrid-1 after iconList-1, m9 before m10).

findings.issue: Still open: on desktops the iconList item titles ('Standalone orders', 'Exposure and finish', 'Colour approval') and the FAQ questions are fitted almost as large as their section headings, while featureGrid-1 and m9 use small bold item titles, so the page shows two sizes for list titles and the item level crowds the heading.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps its bold sub-heads ('Pricing Custom Swimwear Designs', 'Ready Designs', 'Custom Designs') just above body size, clearly below its section headings.
findings.fix: In the shared heading-fit step, cap the fitted size of an item h3 (icon-list item, FAQ question) on desktops as is already done on phones, e.g. at about 0.65 of its section h2's fitted size.

findings.issue: Still open: the photo in the blush panel row sits inset inside the blush, with about 40px of blush above and below it and its outer edge on the content column rather than the section's edge; at 390px a blush strip of about 35px still sits under the photo before m8.
findings.reference: The competitor's 'Sampling' split runs its photo to the panel's top, bottom and outer edge, so the blush copy panel and the photo meet as two flush halves (on phones the photo ends the section).
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css set .block--split[data-variant="panel"] to padding-block: 0 and let its media column run to the section's outer edge (the copy column keeps its own padding); below 768px also drop the padding under the photo.

findings.issue: At 390px the first figure '2 to 3 working days' wraps to two lines while '300 pcs' beside it takes one, so the labels in the first row sit at different heights ('QUOTATION TURNAROUND' about 24px below 'BRANDED ZIP-LOCK MINIMUM') and the two-by-two grid looks uneven.
findings.reference: The competitor has no trust bar; in its card rows, parts of the same kind line up across the row.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css make each .trust-bar item a flex column with its label pushed to the bottom (margin-top: auto on the label), so labels in the same row line up whatever the figure's line count.

findings.issue: At 390px the empty top-left header cell of the tinted cost table stays white, cutting a notch out of the panel's corner, and the bold row labels ('Stone embellishment', 'Hardware and beads') run to within about 10px of the next column.
findings.reference: The competitor's tables and panels keep one fill and even cell padding throughout.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css give the faq-charts table's empty corner th a transparent background (inherit the panel tint), and widen the right padding of its first column on phones.
